entities.name: Query protein uS9c
observations: 134 aa basic protein; predicted molecular weight 15.14 kDa, pI 10.60, and charge at pH 7 of +19.6.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A0T0Z6, annotated as small ribosomal subunit protein uS9c.
Contains Pfam Ribosomal_S9 domain PF00380.26 at positions 13–134 with i-Evalue 1.8e-39.

entities.name: A0T0Z6
observations: Reviewed Thalassiosira pseudonana uS9c reference; exact sequence match with 100% identity and full coverage.
Annotated to chloroplast, small ribosomal subunit, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation.

entities.name: Small ribosomal subunit
observations: The query protein is annotated as a structural constituent of the small ribosomal subunit and is expected to participate in plastid translation.

entities.name: Chloroplast
observations: Reviewed homologs from Thalassiosira pseudonana, Phaeodactylum tricornutum, and Trieres chinensis are annotated to the chloroplast/plastid.
